name: Webform Mautic
description: Allows to send Webform submissions as contacts through Mautic forms.
project_description:
This module integrates your Webform submissions with Mautic form submissions.

 If you have an existing Drupal 8/9 site and you're using the Webform module, you're probably wondering how you can send your existing Webform submissions to Mautic , to convert them to contacts.

Look no further, this module adds a Webform handler to map your webform to a Mautic form.

 
 How to Configure: 
 Visit Send Drupal Webform Submissions to Mautic for a detailed guide.

 
 Features: 
 
 Adds a Webform handler to map submissions to Mautic forms. 
 Automatically send Mautic cookies (session and device ID), to merge the newly created contact from the submission with the anonymous tracked visitor through the tracking pixel seamlessly. 
 Automatically forward the IP address to Mautic, to provide consistent tracking of leads once they submit the form. 
 
 
 This module is sponsored and developed by Vardot.
